description: The Eagan Matrix effects section, which Haken Audio calls the recirculator: one of seven effects with six parameters and a wet mix; it works through a CHEM Core

params.text: Sets the first parameter of the chosen effect, printed Diffuse in the two reverbs, ModDepth in the two modulated delays, Noise in the analog echo, and LPF or HPF in the two filtered delays
Sets the second parameter of the chosen effect, printed LPF in the two reverbs, ModRate in the two modulated delays, and Offset in the four echoes and delays
Sets the third parameter of the chosen effect, printed Damping in the two reverbs and Feedback in the five delays and echoes
Sets the fourth parameter of the chosen effect, printed Decay in the two reverbs and Time in the five delays and echoes
Sets the pre-delay of the two reverbs; on the other five effects the knob greys out and the panel prints an em dash
Sets the high-pass filter of the two reverbs; on the other five effects the knob greys out and the panel prints an em dash
Sets how much of the effect is mixed with the straight signal
Sets how far the voltage at the selected input moves its control, from -100% to 100%, a negative amount inverting the voltage; the knob does nothing until a cable is patched
Turns the whole effects section off, which matches Disable Recirculator in the Haken Editor
Chooses the effect: Short reverb, Mod delay, Swept delay, Analog echo, Delay with LPF, Delay with HPF or Long reverb, and relabels the six parameter knobs to match

inputs.text: Moves the parameter of the same number away from its knob setting, bipolar, scaled by the modulation amount knob and clamped to 0-10V
Moves the effects mix away from its knob setting, bipolar, scaled by the modulation amount knob and clamped to 0-10V

notes: nothing reaches the instrument until the module is linked to a CHEM Core; putting it beside a linked CHEM module links it, or click the link button at the bottom of the panel to pick a Core
one input at a time is under the modulation amount knob; patching a cable moves the knob to that jack and lights the lamp beside it, and clicking a jack or its label moves the knob to that one
menu: Zero modulation — sets the modulation amount on every input of this module to zero
Center knobs — sets the six parameter knobs to the middle of their range
